content_of_post_to_comment: He’s right. I can forgive tax evasion, supplying surveillance tools to human rights abusers, and targeting teenagers with deliberately addictive marketing instruments. But putting us in touch with each other was a low blow.
comment: The deeper irony is that connection itself became the disruptive technology. The same networks that enable abuse also weaken old gatekeepers, which may explain why they provoke such unusual backlash.
